scope: Informed nonauthor independent tree construction and full-leaf exact polyhedral audit for Port10 w=(17t,B,22t,D)>0, all 1935 directions, legal optimizer and exact strict 3/2 near-set, binary homogeneous strict comparisons.
method: Rebuild 197-line exact positive projective arrangement and search a depth-seven tree on reduced-bank samples. Then bypass bank-completeness assumptions: independently verify every feasible leaf using all 1935 directions and exact homogeneous polygon clipping. A leaf is described by weak linear halfspaces plus strict ones (including positivity). A closed intersection meets every strict constraint iff for each strict constraint at least one vertex is positive, since their positive sum works. For each direction exclude F_v<eta by strict feasibility, prove F_v<=eta for a fixed upper witness on entire leaf closure, test each included near inequality's nonpositive intersection and exclude each omitted direction's simultaneous strict near inequalities. Strict and weak branches are distinct, including equality. All exact integer arithmetic. Any failing leaf is retained as unresolved.
